neet_phy_u15_t00_1.working: Displacement current is ε0 dΦE/dt. It arises from the time-varying electric flux between the plates, not from charges crossing the gap.

neet_phy_u15_t00_3.working: Inside the plates, B = μ0 Id r/(2πR²) = 4πe-7 × 2 × 0.025/(2π × 0.0025) = 4e-6 T

neet_phy_u15_t00_4.working: After full charging, the field is constant, so dΦ/dt = 0 and the displacement current is zero. A is false; R is true.

neet_phy_u15_t00_5.working: I is false: B is zero on the axis and grows linearly with r inside the plates. II is false: the displacement current equals the conduction current.
